scripts.infra:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix eduspark && npm install --prefix eduspark-chat-server && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "NEXT,CHAT" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix eduspark" "npm run dev --prefix eduspark-chat-server"
